package answer

import (
	"context"
	"encoding/json"
	"time"

	"github.com/example/ms-student-service/internal/domain"
)

// TaskMetadata is fetched from ms-course-service.
type TaskMetadata struct {
	CompletionFactType         string                     `json:"_completion_fact_type,omitempty"`
	CompletionSourceRevisionID string                     `json:"_completion_source_revision_id,omitempty"`
	ID                         string                     `json:"id"`
	LessonID                   string                     `json:"lesson_id"`
	CourseID                   string                     `json:"course_id"`
	Title                      string                     `json:"title"`
	Description                string                     `json:"description"`
	Status                     int                        `json:"status"`
	LearningTargets            []domain.LearningTargetRef `json:"learning_targets"`
	Type                       int16                      `json:"type"`
	TaskKind                   string                     `json:"task_kind"`
	CodeStructureType          string                     `json:"code_structure_type_code"`
	CodeStructure              json.RawMessage            `json:"code_structure"`
	ComposeConfig              json.RawMessage            `json:"compose_config"`
	AllowedErrorsCount         int                        `json:"allowed_errors_count"`
	StarterFiles               []TaskStarterFileMetadata  `json:"starter_files"`
	Tests                      []TaskTestMetadata         `json:"tests"`
	ExecutionMode              string                     `json:"execution_mode"`
	EvaluationMode             string                     `json:"evaluation_mode"`
	UIMode                     string                     `json:"ui_mode"`
	SubmissionMode             string                     `json:"submission_mode"`
	RequiresSandbox            bool                       `json:"requires_sandbox"`
	ExposesPreview             bool                       `json:"exposes_preview"`
	ExposesTerminal            bool                       `json:"exposes_terminal"`
	SupportsLiveValidation     bool                       `json:"supports_live_validation"`
	MaxAttempts                *int                       `json:"max_attempts"`
	DeadlineAt                 *time.Time                 `json:"deadline_at"`
	Version                    int64                      `json:"version"`
	UpdatedAt                  time.Time                  `json:"updated_at"`
	AssessmentPurpose          string                     `json:"assessment_purpose"`
	Locked                     bool                       `json:"locked"`
	Completed                  bool                       `json:"completed"`
	Current                    bool                       `json:"current"`
	Readonly                   bool                       `json:"readonly"`
	BlockingReason             string                     `json:"blocking_reason"`
	RedirectLessonID           string                     `json:"redirect_lesson_id"`
	RedirectTaskID             string                     `json:"redirect_task_id"`
	IsPracticeTaskRuntime      bool                       `json:"is_practice_task_runtime"`
}

type TaskStarterFileMetadata struct {
	Type          int16  `json:"type"`
	FileStorageID string `json:"filestorage_id"`
	Order         int    `json:"order"`
}

type TaskTestMetadata struct {
	ID          string                    `json:"id"`
	Kind        string                    `json:"kind"`
	Title       string                    `json:"title"`
	Description string                    `json:"description"`
	Order       int                       `json:"order"`
	Groups      []TaskTestGroupMetadata   `json:"groups"`
	Variants    []TaskTestVariantMetadata `json:"variants"`
}

type TaskTestGroupMetadata struct {
	ID    string `json:"id"`
	Title string `json:"title"`
	Order int    `json:"order"`
}

type TaskTestVariantMetadata struct {
	ID             string `json:"id"`
	Text           string `json:"text"`
	IsCorrect      bool   `json:"is_correct"`
	CorrectOrder   *int   `json:"correct_order"`
	GroupID        string `json:"group_id"`
	GroupSourceKey string `json:"group_source_key"`
	Order          int    `json:"order"`
}

type LessonMetadata struct {
	ID          string
	CourseID    string
	Title       string
	Excerpt     string
	Description string
	Order       int
	Status      int
}

type CourseStructure struct {
	CourseID string
	Lessons  []CourseStructureLesson
}

type CourseStructureLesson struct {
	ID          string
	CourseID    string
	Title       string
	Description string
	Order       int
	Status      int
	Tasks       []CourseStructureTask
}

type CourseStructureTask struct {
	ID             string
	LessonID       string
	CourseID       string
	Title          string
	Description    string
	Type           int16
	EvaluationMode string
	Order          int
	Status         int
}

// TaskProvider fetches task metadata from course service.
type TaskProvider interface {
	GetTask(ctx context.Context, taskID string) (*TaskMetadata, error)
	GetCourseStructure(ctx context.Context, courseID string) (*CourseStructure, error)
}

type LessonProvider interface {
	GetLesson(ctx context.Context, lessonID string) (*LessonMetadata, error)
}

type AssignedCourseAccess interface {
	CanAccessCourse(ctx context.Context, studentID, courseID string) (bool, error)
}

// LessonAssessmentTaskResolver reads only the exact Student-owned frozen assignment.
type LessonAssessmentTaskResolver interface {
	ResolveAssessmentTask(ctx context.Context, studentID, itemID, requirementID, taskID string) (*TaskMetadata, error)
}

// taskForAnswer never consults mutable Course metadata for a correlated attempt.
func taskForAnswer(ctx context.Context, provider TaskProvider, attempt *domain.StudentTaskAnswer) (*TaskMetadata, error) {
	if attempt.LearningPathItemID != "" || attempt.RequirementID != "" {
		if attempt.LearningPathItemID == "" || attempt.RequirementID == "" || len(attempt.FrozenTaskJSON) == 0 {
			return nil, domain.ErrValidation
		}
		var task TaskMetadata
		if err := json.Unmarshal(attempt.FrozenTaskJSON, &task); err != nil || task.ID != attempt.TaskID {
			return nil, domain.ErrValidation
		}
		return &task, nil
	}
	if provider == nil {
		return nil, domain.ErrValidation
	}
	return provider.GetTask(WithTaskLookupContext(ctx, attempt.StudentID, attempt.ID), attempt.TaskID)
}

func requireAnswerTaskUnlocked(ctx context.Context, progression *ProgressionService, attempt *domain.StudentTaskAnswer) error {
	if attempt.LearningPathItemID != "" {
		return nil
	}
	return progression.RequireTaskUnlocked(ctx, attempt.StudentID, attempt.TaskID)
}
